authorization: User asked to replace the boat and update the experience accordingly.
geometry: 14846 triangles, original proportions preserved; hull, fittings, sail, lacing and paired oars separated for animation
textures: Supplied base colour and normal maps converted to 2048px WebP; supplied roughness and metallic maps packed into glTF channels. Height map is retained in the original archive and not used for displacement.
fit: Hull centred on the boat axis; keel at -0.35 m; seated eye at (0,1.10,1.81) m; measured 65-point water exclusion profile.
motion: Forward-facing push rowing with two supplied oars, fixed rowing pivots, contact-based entry/pull/exit, feathered recovery, stow/pickup and damped hull roll. Supplied cloth and lacing lower onto the boom while the mast stays fixed.
textureMapping: FBX V coordinates inverted during glTF conversion so base colour, normal and packed roughness/metallic all sample their original atlas regions. Sail uses the supplied white woven cloth.
materialResponse: sRGB base-colour sampling and display encoding; separate non-metallic matte sailcloth with light transmission and restrained wet gloss. No emissive fabric lighting.
